name: Velvet Lou
description: A cheerful lounge performer in a deep green velvet jacket over a cream shirt, with a tall dark quiff, a thin moustache, and a relaxed stage presence. Holds a chrome handheld microphone in his character-right hand at all times.

animations.dance: Relaxed club two-step that rocks the hips side to side and returns naturally to frame 0.

location: A small hotel cocktail lounge after midnight: a curved bar in dark polished wood along the back wall, brass rail, rows of bottles lit from below, a scatter of empty round tables with low amber lamps, and heavy burgundy drapes at the sides.
